scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c green,blue "pnpm --filter vite-demo dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && pnpm build:main && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE ELECTRON_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.stage:renderer: rm -rf staging/renderer && mkdir -p staging && cp -r ../vite-demo/dist staging/renderer && rm -rf staging/renderer/disks
scripts.package: pnpm build && pnpm stage:renderer && bash scripts/collect-native.sh linux staging/native-linux && bash scripts/package.sh --platform=linux --arch=x64 --native-dir=staging/native-linux
scripts.package:win: pnpm build && pnpm stage:renderer && pnpm stage:native:win64 && bash scripts/collect-native.sh win32 staging/native-win32 && bash scripts/package.sh --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --native-dir=staging/native-win32
scripts.package:wasm: pnpm build && pnpm stage:renderer && bash scripts/package.sh --platform=linux --arch=x64 --no-native
scripts.package:win:wasm: pnpm build && pnpm stage:renderer && bash scripts/package.sh --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --no-native
scripts.package:mac:wasm: pnpm build && pnpm stage:renderer && bash scripts/package.sh --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --no-native
